sentences.en: jeanne : Hi Thomas, how are you enjoying the course so far?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 嗨，Thomas，到目前为止，你对这门课程感觉如何？

sentences.en: thomas : Yeah, I think it's good.
sentences.zh: thomas: 嗯，我觉得挺不错的。

sentences.en: jeanne : Remind me – why did you decide to study sports science?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 提醒我一下——你当初为什么决定学习运动科学？

sentences.en: Didn't you want to be a professional athlete when you were at school?
sentences.zh: 你上学时不是想成为一名职业运动员吗？

sentences.en: thomas : Yeah – that was my goal, and all my classmates assumed I would achieve it; they thought I was brilliant.
sentences.zh: thomas: 是啊——那曾是我的目标，而且我所有的同学都认为我一定能实现；他们觉得我特别出色。

sentences.en: jeanne : That must have been a nice feeling.
sentences.zh: jeanne: 那种感觉一定很棒吧。

sentences.en: thomas : Mm, I thought I could win anything.
sentences.zh: thomas: 嗯，我当时觉得自己能赢下任何比赛。

sentences.en: There was no one who could run faster than me.
sentences.zh: 没人能跑得比我更快。

sentences.en: jeanne : Exactly – so what happened?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 没错——那么后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Did your mum and dad want you to be more ‘academic'?
sentences.zh: 你父母是不是希望你更‘学术’一点？

sentences.en: thomas : Not at all.
sentences.zh: thomas: 完全不是。

sentences.en: Perhaps they should have pushed me harder, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，也许他们本该对我要求更严格些。

sentences.en: jeanne : What do you mean?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: thomas : I think I should have practised more.
sentences.zh: thomas: 我觉得我当时应该多加练习。

sentences.en: jeanne : What makes you say that?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 你为什么会这么说？

sentences.en: thomas : Well, I went out to Kenya for a couple of weeks to train …
sentences.zh: thomas: 嗯，我曾去肯尼亚训练了几个星期……

sentences.en: jeanne : Really!
sentences.zh: jeanne: 真的吗！

sentences.en: I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 我之前都不知道这事。

sentences.en: thomas : I was chosen to go there out of loads of kids and run with some of the top teenage athletes in the world.
sentences.zh: thomas: 我是从众多孩子中被选中前往那里，与世界上一些顶尖的青少年运动员一同训练。

sentences.en: And …
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: I was so calm about it.
sentences.zh: 我对这件事表现得异常平静。

sentences.en: I just kept thinking how fortunate I was.
sentences.zh: 我只是一直想着自己多么幸运。

sentences.en: What a great chance this was!
sentences.zh: 这是多么难得的机会啊！

sentences.en: Everyone back home was so proud of me.
sentences.zh: 家乡的每个人都为我感到骄傲。

sentences.en: But once we started competing, I very quickly realised I wasn't good enough.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我们开始比赛，我很快就意识到自己还不够优秀。

sentences.en: jeanne : That must have been a huge shock.
sentences.zh: jeanne: 这一定是个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: thomas : I thought ‘this can't be happening '!
sentences.zh: thomas: 我当时心想：‘这不可能发生！’

sentences.en: I was used to winning.
sentences.zh: 我早已习惯了获胜。

sentences.en: /22 /22 /24 /24 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts jeanne : I'm sorry to hear that.
sentences.zh: /22 /22 /24 /24 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts jeanne: 听到这个消息我很抱歉。

sentences.en: thomas : It's OK.
sentences.zh: thomas: 没关系。

sentences.en: I'm over it now and I think it's much better to do a university course and this one has such a variety of sports-related areas.
sentences.zh: 我现在已走出来了，而且我觉得读大学课程要好得多，而这一门课程涵盖了许多与体育相关的领域。

sentences.en: It's going to be good.
sentences.zh: 它会非常棒。

sentences.en: jeanne : Oh, I agree – I chose it because of that.
sentences.zh: jeanne: 哦，我完全同意——我当初选择它也正是出于这个原因。

sentences.en: thomas : So Jeanne – have you thought of any ideas for the discussion session next week on technology and sport?
sentences.zh: thomas: 那么Jeanne，你有没有为下周关于‘科技与体育’的讨论课想出什么点子？

sentences.en: jeanne : We have to cover more than one sport, don't we?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 我们得覆盖不止一项运动，对吧？

sentences.en: thomas : Yeah.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的。

sentences.en: jeanne : You know – we always think technology is about the future, but we could gather some ideas about past developments in sport.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：你知道——我们总以为科技关乎未来，但其实也可以搜集一些关于体育运动过去发展历程的资料。

sentences.en: thomas : Look at early types of equipment perhaps?
sentences.zh: 托马斯：或许可以看看早期的运动器材？

sentences.en: Uh, I remember reading something about table tennis bats once – how they ended up being covered with pimpled rubber.
sentences.zh: 呃，我记得以前读过一篇关于乒乓球拍的文章——它们最终被覆上了带颗粒的橡胶。

sentences.en: jeanne : Cos they were just wooden at first, I'd imagine.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：我猜最初只是木制的吧。

sentences.en: thomas : Yeah.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的。

sentences.en: In about the 1920s, a factory was making rolls of the rubber in bulk for something like horse harnesses.
sentences.zh: 大约在20世纪20年代，一家工厂大批量生产这种橡胶卷材，用途类似马具。

sentences.en: jeanne : Really!
sentences.zh: 珍妮：真的吗！

sentences.en: thomas : Yeah – and someone realised that it'd make a perfect covering for the wooden bats.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的——后来有人意识到，这种橡胶非常适合作为木制球拍的覆盖层。

sentences.en: jeanne : So what about cricket – that's had a few innovative changes.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：那板球呢——它也经历过不少创新性变革。

sentences.en: Maybe the pads they wear on their legs?
sentences.zh: 比如球员护腿用的护垫？

sentences.en: thomas : I don't think they've changed much but, I'm just looking on the internet … and it says that when the first cricket helmet came in, in 1978, the Australian batsman who first wore it was booed and jeered by people watching because it was so ugly!
sentences.zh: 托马斯：我觉得护垫本身变化不大，不过我刚上网查了一下……上面说，1978年首次出现板球头盔时，第一位佩戴它的澳大利亚击球手遭到了现场观众的嘘声和嘲笑，只因头盔外观实在太丑了！

sentences.en: jeanne : Wow, players have to protect themselves from getting hurt!
sentences.zh: 珍妮：哇，球员们必须保护自己免受伤害啊！

sentences.en: I mean everyone wears one now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，现在人人都戴头盔了。

sentences.en: thomas : Mm, unlike the cycle helmet.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：嗯，这跟自行车头盔可不一样。

sentences.en: jeanne : Well, unless you're a professional, but you're right, many ordinary bikers don't wear a helmet.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：嗯，除非你是职业选手；不过你说得对，许多普通骑行者并不戴头盔。

sentences.en: thomas : Hey, look at these pictures of original helmet designs.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：嘿，快看这些原始头盔设计的图片。

sentences.en: This one looks like an upside-down bowl!
sentences.zh: 这个看起来像个倒扣的碗！

sentences.en: jeanne : Yet, the woman's laughing – she's so proud to be wearing it!
sentences.zh: 珍妮：可那位女士却在笑——她戴着它还特别自豪呢！

sentences.en: thomas : It says serious cyclists ended up with wet hair from all the hard exercise.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：上面写着，严肃的自行车手因剧烈运动而满头大汗。

sentences.en: jeanne : I guess that's why they have large air vents in them now so that the skin can breathe more easily.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：我想这就是为什么如今头盔上都设计了大型通风孔，以便皮肤更易透气。

sentences.en: thomas : OK, so we've done helmets.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：好，头盔这部分我们已经讲完了。

sentences.en: What about golf balls or better still golf clubs – they've changed a lot.
sentences.zh: 那高尔夫球呢？或者更好的是高尔夫球杆——它们的变化可就大多了。

sentences.en: jeanne : Yeah – I remember my great grandfather telling me that because a club was made entirely of wood, it would easily break and players had to get another.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：是啊——我记得我曾祖父告诉过我，由于球杆完全由木材制成，很容易断裂，球员不得不另换一支。

sentences.en: thomas : There's no wood at all in them now, is there?
sentences.zh: 托马斯：现在球杆里一点木头都没有了吧？

sentences.en: jeanne : No – they're much more powerful.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：没有了——现在的球杆威力大得多。

sentences.en: thomas : The same must be true of hockey sticks.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：曲棍球杆应该也是如此。

sentences.en: jeanne : I don't think so because players still use wooden sticks today.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：我觉得未必，因为如今球员仍在使用木制球杆。

sentences.en: What it does say here, though, is that when the game started you had to produce a stick yourself.
sentences.zh: 不过这里提到，这项运动刚兴起时，球员得自己动手制作球杆。

sentences.en: thomas : I guess they just weren't being manufactured.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：我猜当时根本还没有量产。

sentences.en: So, one more perhaps.
sentences.zh: 那么，再举一个例子吧。

sentences.en: What about football?
sentences.zh: 足球呢？

sentences.en: jeanne : Well, I know the first balls were made of animal skin.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：哦，我知道最早的足球是用动物皮做的。

sentences.en: thomas : Yeah, they covered them with pieces of leather that were stitched together, but …
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的，人们用缝合在一起的皮革片包裹球体，但……

sentences.en: the balls let in water when it rained.
sentences.zh: 下雨时球会渗水。

sentences.en: jeanne : Oh, that would have made them much heavier.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：哦，那样一来球就会重得多。
